_comment: Golden output for the fixture repository. Every value here is derivable from the files by hand, and is what a correct run must produce. A run that disagrees is either wrong or has found a defect in this file — check by hand, never by adjusting the expectation to match the run.

token_sources.proves: a projection pair: 2 SCSS variables emitting 2 custom properties
3 real declarations no entry point reaches
a bare package spec (ui/theme.css) resolved through the workspace to packages/ui/src/; defines no tokens

counts._token_count_note: 21 concepts. 20 from before, plus --spacing declared in @theme, which is a theme root. Two traps here: $accent/--accent and $accent-soft/--accent-soft are one concept each (a run reporting 23 skipped deduplication), and --panel-gap is declared inside .panel, a component rule, so it is scoped state and never counted (a run reporting 22 counted by file instead of by selector scope).
counts._spacing_note: --spacing is declared in @theme and again under .theme-compact, a scheme class. One name, two roots, counted once. A run reporting 22 counted the override as a second token.

inventory_families._note: 19 families total. A run reporting 0 for an absent family rather than the absent state fails validate_run rule 4.
inventory_families._spacing_note: --spacing joins spacing; the family stays measured.

uncovered.why: Only Tailwind's derived scale (--spacing x 5) covers 20px. A derived scale is one token, the multiplier, and a step generated from it has no name to swap to. A run classifying this redundant has counted framework steps as named tokens.

leaks._scope_note: Leaks come from owned reachable consumer files only. node_modules/pkg/theme.css holds #2563eb and 8px and must never appear; dist/bundle.css holds #2563eb and must never appear.
leaks._grading_note: Three findings (distinct literal-to-token pairs), four occurrences (8px appears in two files). leakage grades on findings: 3 is attention. A run grading on occurrences reads the same data as 4, still attention here, and as fail on a larger codebase — which is how two runs split on shadcn.

fix_queue._note: Only the three redundant groups. Near-miss needs a person to decide whether the drift was deliberate; uncovered needs a token to exist first.

vitals._mode_note: theme.config.json declares high-contrast and no source resolves it. A run grading this pass, attention or fail fails validate_run rule 3.
vitals._enforcement_note: no lint config and no CI in the fixture
